public_rationale: The May 16, 2023 hearing summary records Altman’s offer to work with Durbin on a liability framework [e1]. It does not establish whether collaboration followed through June 11, 2026 or what Marcus knew at publication [e1]. This evidence therefore cannot verify or refute the claim qualified by “as far I know” [e1].
limitations: The evidence does not establish whether relevant collaboration occurred between the hearing and publication.

The evidence does not independently establish Marcus’s knowledge at publication. Public documentation alone would not establish his awareness, and an unsuccessful search would not establish that no collaboration occurred.

public_payload.normalized_proposition: As far as Marcus knows, Altman did nothing with Senator Durbin to find an alternative to Section 230 after promising to collaborate.

statement.excerpt: And as far I know he didn’t do diddly squat with Senator Durbin to find an alternative to Section 230.
statement.document_title: Maybe Section 230 doesn’t shield AI companies from liability, after all

from_speaker: to find an alternative to Section 230
our_interpretation: The statement concerns collaboration after the May 16, 2023 hearing and through publication on June 11, 2026.

The knowledge qualification is part of the claim. Marcus expresses his understanding that Altman had done nothing with Durbin on this subject; he does not assert independently verified absence of collaboration.

A public record of collaboration would establish activity, but would not by itself establish that Marcus knew about it. An unsuccessful search would establish neither absence of collaboration nor Marcus’s state of knowledge.
criteria.support_condition: Independent evidence would need to establish that Marcus’s qualified account accurately represented his knowledge at publication. Public silence alone is insufficient.
criteria.contradiction_condition: Evidence would need to establish relevant collaboration and that Marcus knew of it before publication. The existence or public availability of collaboration records alone would not contradict the knowledge qualification.
